cohort: 693 patients with endometrioid adenocarcinoma who underwent either laparoscopy or laparotomy between January 2012 and July 2020
finding: Compared to laparotomy, laparoscopic surgery for endometrioid adenocarcinoma was associated with faster surgical recovery (shorter operative time, lower intraoperative bleeding volume, and shorter postoperative hospital stay) and lower postoperative recurrence rates, particularly for remote recurrence.
